What You’ll Do
 Our team turns complex business questions into actionable insights and products that the business actually uses. You will work directly with stakeholders, challenge assumptions, and build fast, iterative solutions that improve week by week. If you value curiosity over certainty and real impact over busywork, you will thrive here.
"- Work with stakeholders to turn unclear requests into clear business problems through structured discovery and thoughtful questioning.
 Assess data availability and quality through exploratory analysis, then transform raw data into clean, trusted datasets ready for reporting.
 Design data models that reflect real business logic, not just technical structure.
 Build MVP dashboards early and iterate them in short cycles based on real user feedback.
 Communicate insights clearly and present outcomes to non-technical stakeholders.
 Create well-documented data products and processes so others can understand, trust, and reuse your work.
 Actively contribute to the team: share knowledge, support others, and build on each other’s ideas to solve problems better together.
 Identify opportunities to automate processes and build scalable solutions beyond dashboards."
 Qualifications

 Ability to structure work as reusable products: documenting logic, calculations, and processes so others can build on your work.
